articles.title: Beijing fights invasive moths with parasitic wasps and caterpillar-catching contests
articles.summary:
Authorities in the Chinese capital are releasing more than a billion parasitic wasps and encouraging caterpillar-catching competitions to try to contain the spread of the invasive North American fall webworm.
The caterpillars have blanketed trees in Beijing and surrounding areas this summer, spinning clouds of greyish-white webs as they eat their way through foliage.
The insects are the fuzzy larval stage of Hyphantria cunea and metamorphose into adult white moths.

articles.title: TCM or Western medicine for sports injuries? Why this Hong Kong athlete chose both
articles.summary:
In the third instalment of a four-part Health Matters series on traditional Chinese medicine, Aidyn Fitzpatrick speaks to a Hong Kong fencer studying TCM and local practitioners to see how athletes, both elite and amateur, are using TCM alongside Western medicine for smarter injury recovery.
Fresh off helping Hong Kong clinch a bronze medal in the women’s foil team event at the 2026 Asian Games in Japan, fencer Janelle Leung Ya-lei – ranked 53rd in the world – knows the fine margin between peak...

articles.title: China’s only monogamous emperor: why Hongzhi refused a harem, remained dedicated to wife
articles.summary:
It is no secret that Chinese emperors had many women in their lives, and the imperial concubine system was a significant feature of feudal social structures.
Ming-era (1368–1644) emperors could have upwards of 9,000 consorts, ostensibly to ensure an heir. Unfortunately, these women often existed in gilded prisons, barred from leaving the palace grounds and frequently subject to the wrath of a cruel emperor.
However, one leader stands out for doing just the opposite; the Hongzhi Emperor (r....

articles.title: Hong Kong set to begin importing hundreds of carers from second half of 2027
articles.summary:
Hong Kong will begin importing hundreds of foreign domestic carers as early as the second half of 2027 under a new pilot scheme, with their pay up to 20 per cent higher than that of domestic helpers, the city’s labour minister has said.
Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun Yuk-han said on Sunday that the carers would be equipped with both specialised elderly care skills and general domestic capabilities, and would first need to complete a 150-hour course in their home country.
“We now need...

articles.title: Hong Kong should review reducing number of Legco seats to cut costs, Rita Fan says
articles.summary:
Hong Kong’s first Legislative Council president following the city’s return to Chinese sovereignty in 1997 has suggested reviewing the number of seats in Legco, citing the need to use public funds properly.
Rita Fan Hsu Lai-tai also said on Sunday that Hong Kong and Shenzhen authorities had discussed the development of a plot at the two cities’ border before the 1997 handover, but the plan failed because of opposition within the government.
Fan made the remarks during an appearance on a radio...

articles.title: Taipei’s dilemma over history deepens with Xi-Trump praise of WWII Flying Tigers
articles.summary:
Taipei’s dilemma over its history during World War II appeared to deepen as Beijing and Washington looked to the Flying Tigers as a source of connection and goodwill during last month’s Xi–Trump summit.
US President Donald Trump’s description of China as an American ally during the war has raised concerns in Taiwan that what could have been a valuable historical connection with the United States ended up benefiting Beijing’s ties with Washington.
The dilemma resurfaced after Trump and Chinese...

articles.title: 66% of Hong Kong’s 8-year-olds could be short-sighted by 2028, experts warn
articles.summary:
More than 60 per cent of Hong Kong’s eight-year-olds could be short-sighted by 2028, optometrists have predicted, citing a shrinking “hyperopic reserve” that normally helps delay nearsightedness.
The Hong Kong Association of Private Practice Optometrists released the findings on Sunday from a screening of more than 3,500 pupils at eight primary schools conducted between November and May, urging parents to begin comprehensive eye checks when children turned three.
The association found that 67...

articles.title: China’s hospital ships project a different kind of naval power in Africa
articles.summary:
When the Auspicious Ark entered Dakar, Senegal, on September 25, the scene looked closer to a public health mission than a naval deployment. Senegalese people and members of the Chinese community were waiting at the port as the vessel arrived for the first visit by a Chinese naval hospital ship to Senegal.
The Auspicious Ark is a PLA Navy vessel. That places the visit within a wider Chinese maritime presence in Africa, something more often associated with anti-piracy patrols, port calls,...

articles.title: China lashes out at Xinjiang ‘lie’ after US lawmaker urges Starbucks to close new stores
articles.summary:
Beijing has hit back at a US lawmaker’s criticism of coffee chain Starbucks for opening its first stores in Xinjiang, rejecting the allegation that China has committed human rights abuses against the far-western region’s mostly Muslim Uygur population.
Foreign ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun on Saturday said claims of “genocide” in Xinjiang were a “blatant lie” and accused the “US group” who raised the suggestions of attacking Beijing for political purposes.
“Today’s Xinjiang enjoys social...

articles.title: 5 dead in 3 weeks: are Indonesia’s whale strandings on the rise?
articles.summary:
A cluster of whale and whale shark strandings across Indonesia – five in the past three weeks alone – has raised questions over whether such incidents are becoming more frequent, with experts pointing to a mix of environmental shifts, human activity and improved reporting as possible explanations.
On September 25, a whale shark became stranded and died on a beach in Aceh province, just days after a decomposed whale carcass was discovered in a mangrove in Riau province. Another whale was found...

articles.title: More Hong Kong homes sell at a loss despite signs prices have bottomed: agents
articles.summary:
Despite signs that Hong Kong property prices could have bottomed out and begun rebounding in August, market sources said at least 100 secondary residential homes were sold at a loss in September, up from at least 81 the previous month.
Hong Kong’s property market dodged an immediate setback from the US Federal Reserve’s rate increase in September, and agents estimated that home prices could end the year 15 per cent higher than a year earlier. The positive trend, however, did not generally apply...

articles.title: Flight to Okinawa diverts back to Hong Kong after suspected landing gear fault
articles.summary:
A flight bound for Okinawa returned to Hong Kong airport on Sunday morning after its landing gear was suspected to have failed to fully retract after take-off.
Hong Kong Airlines said the crew of flight HX676, which departed at 8.57am, decided to return to ensure safety, in line with standard procedures.
“[The flight] encountered a suspected incomplete landing gear retraction issue after take-off,” the airline said.
The aircraft landed safely at 10am, with no injuries reported on board. The...

articles.title: Hong Kong’s IPO haul more than doubles to HK$388b in first 9 months: Paul Chan
articles.summary:
Funds raised through initial public offerings in Hong Kong more than doubled year on year to over HK$388 billion (US$49.4 billion) in the first nine months of 2026, already surpassing the total amount for the whole of last year, Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po has said.
Adding to the positive outlook, Clara Chan Ka-chai, CEO of the government-owned Hong Kong Investment Corporation (HKIC), noted on Sunday that more than 30 of its portfolio firms were preparing to apply for Hong Kong listings...

articles.title: Japan’s Takaichi presses US after marine arrested over murder-robbery of woman
articles.summary:
A 20-year-old US marine was arrested on Sunday in Japan’s Okinawa prefecture on suspicion of robbing and murdering a local woman, police said.
Davin Ballard stationed at the Futenma Airbase is suspected of killing Anna Yagi, 39, and taking her wallet and backpack in the early hours of Saturday at a hotel in Naha, according to the Okinawa prefectural police. The suspect has denied the charges, they added.
Ballard was seen entering the hotel with Yagi, who was found dead on Saturday morning,...

articles.title: New Mong Kok bookshop opens amid harsh winter for indie outlets in Hong Kong
articles.summary:
Small independent bookstores tucked away in walk-up tenement buildings above neon-lit streets have long made Mong Kok a sanctuary for Hong Kong book lovers, until recently when one after another was forced to close due to economic headwinds or political uncertainty.
Defying the trend, 41-year-old bibliophile Grace Lau invested a six-figure sum to launch New Year Bookshop, a move driven by passion and lower rents that some in the community regarded as a bold gamble on the neighbourhood’s literary...

articles.title: New AI laws should target data governance, safety to build public confidence: experts
articles.summary:
Hong Kong should enact laws on data governance and underlying safety standards to ensure the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI), experts have said, as the government pledged to tackle disputes or crimes involving the technology’s application with tailored legislation.
They also said that legislation was needed to define liability boundaries, which could bolster business and public confidence in expanding its adoption.
Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu said in his recent policy...

articles.title: Indonesians sue their president over haze – can it clear the air?
articles.summary:
For months, the air over West Kalimantan has been thick enough to taste. Now, some of the province’s residents are taking the government to court over it.
Indonesia’s worst wildfire season in 11 years has been sending plumes of toxic haze drifting across borders to Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines since at least August.
But nowhere has been worse hit than West Kalimantan, where more than 48,000 hectares (185 square miles) of land and forest have burned since the start of the year,...

articles.title: Mars shelter problem can be solved with engineered yeast, gelatin and sand: paper
articles.summary:
Future settlers on Mars would need houses, but they must either spend huge sums transporting construction materials from Earth or use enormous amounts of energy to melt Martian soil into bricks.
Scientists in Hong Kong say they have developed a quick and low-cost “living” building material made from genetically engineered yeast, gelatin and sand that can be 3D printed under conditions simulating the Martian environment.
Their study, published online last month in Chem Circularity, an...

articles.title: How Malaysia offers Chinese investors Singapore’s comfort at prices lower than Thailand
articles.summary:
Malaysia is proving to be a middle ground for many Hong Kong and mainland Chinese investors looking to buy property in a country that provides the stability Singapore offers, but with competitive price points similar to those found in Thailand, according to analysts.
Data from Juwai IQI, a property portal with 7 million listings across 111 countries, showed that in the first half of 2026, Malaysia was the fourth-highest destination for inquiries received from Chinese buyers. That compared with...

articles.title: Quality over quantity: China’s AI microdrama producers battle viewer fatigue
articles.summary:
Two decades after stepping away from the spotlight, iconic actress Joey Wong made an unexpected return to the screen – not through a traditional production, but via artificial intelligence-powered reconstruction.
In a two-minute video by NetEase this summer, Wong, one of the most well-known actresses of the 1980s and 90s, had some of her most celebrated roles recreated, including the beautiful ghost in A Chinese Ghost Story and an alluring snake demon in Green Snake.
The revival is just the tip...

archive.security_status_cs: Nedávný summit mezi USA a Čínou přinesl částečné snížení napětí, přičemž prezident Donald Trump bagatelizoval neshody ohledně Tchaj-wanu a přispěl k mírnému regionálnímu uklidnění. V Hongkongu pokračuje institucionální vývoj s důrazem na technologickou spolupráci v oblasti hubu Hetao a posun v pravidlech pro umělou inteligenci. Současně se globální mocenské soupeření rozšiřuje do rozvojových zemí, což dokládá konkurence o kritické nerostné suroviny v Keni.
archive.security_status_en: The recent US-China summit has brought a partial easing of tensions, with President Donald Trump playing down disagreements over Taiwan and contributing to regional stability. In Hong Kong, institutional developments continue with a focus on technology cooperation in the Hetao hub and adaptive AI governance rules. Simultaneously, great-power competition is expanding into emerging markets, as highlighted by the rivalry over critical minerals in Kenya.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech budou trhy vstřebávat dopady zmírněné rétoriky mezi USA a Čínou, přičemž investoři se zaměří na implementaci technologických dohod v Hongkongu a širší regionální stabilitu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will absorb the impacts of the softened US-China rhetoric, with investors focusing on the implementation of technology agreements in Hong Kong and broader regional stability.

archive.security_status_cs: Prezident Xi Jinping posiluje důraz na vnitřní stabilitu a bezpečnost v předvečer sjezdu strany, zatímco regionální ekonomiku nadále pohání silná globální poptávka po AI a infrastruktuře, jako je nový kanál Pinglu. Zároveň přetrvávají technologická rizika, o čemž svědčí vyšetřování citlivých výzkumníků a přísná opatření vůči dezinformacím.
archive.security_status_en: President Xi Jinping is tightening domestic security focus ahead of the upcoming party congress, while the regional economy continues to be driven by robust global demand for AI and infrastructure projects like the Pinglu Canal. Meanwhile, technological friction persists, highlighted by heightened scrutiny over researchers and measures against online disinformation.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se trhy zaměří na dopady čínského svátečního týdne a implementaci nových technologických a inovačních plánů. Pozornost investorů zůstane upřena na makroekonomická data a technologický sektor.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will focus on the impacts of China's Golden Week holiday and the implementation of new technology and innovation plans. Investor attention will remain fixed on macroeconomic data and the tech sector.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí v regionu zůstává zvýšené kvůli pokračujícímu posilování vojenských a technologických kapacit Číny, včetně pokroků v satelitní koordinaci. Mezitím globální investoři projevují obnovený zájem o čínské dluhopisy a biotechnologický sektor, což mírní obavy z širších ekonomických sankcí.
archive.security_status_en: Regional geopolitical tensions remain elevated amid China's ongoing military and technological capacity enhancements, including advancements in satellite coordination. Meanwhile, global investors are showing renewed interest in Chinese bonds and the biotech sector, easing concerns over broader economic sanctions.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat reakci na obchodní jednání mezi EU a Pekingem a další vývoj v oblasti technologických sankcí. Trhy budou nadále sledovat makroekonomický vývoj v Číně.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will likely react to trade negotiations between the EU and Beijing and further developments in tech sanctions. Markets will continue to monitor macroeconomic trends in China.

archive.security_status_cs: Nedávný summit prezidentů Xi a Trumpa sice přinesl prozatímní dvouměsíční prodloužení obchodního příměří, hlubší strukturální spory však zůstávají nevyřešeny. Tchaj-wan mezitím reaguje na hrozbu blokády posílením svých zásob munice programem v hodnotě 850 milionů dolarů.
archive.security_status_en: Although the recent Xi-Trump summit yielded a temporary two-month extension of the trade truce, deeper structural disputes remain unresolved. Meanwhile, Taiwan is responding to blockade risks by bolstering its critical ammunition stockpiles through an $850 million program.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává pokračující diplomatické vyhodnocování summitu Xi-Trump a reakce trhů na vývoj v oblasti dodavatelských řetězců a polovodičů.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will likely continue parsing the outcomes of the Xi-Trump summit and reacting to developments in supply chains and semiconductor policies.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí zůstává zvýšené v důsledku křehkého příměří mezi USA a Čínou a tchajwanských plánů na posílení zásob munice pro případ blokády. Čína mezitím zrychluje technologickou soběstačnost skrze otevřený zdrojový kód pro Huawei čipy, zatímco regionální ekonomické reformy a finanční iniciativy v Hongkongu ukazují na snahu o stabilizaci.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions remain elevated due to the fragile US-China trade truce and Taiwan's plans to quadruple ammunition stocks in preparation for a potential blockade. Meanwhile, China is accelerating technological self-reliance via open-source tools for Huawei chips, while regional economic reforms and financial initiatives in Hong Kong signal efforts toward stabilization.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické manévry ohledně implementace výsledků summitu Xi-Trump a reakce trhů na snahy Číny o technologickou nezávislost.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further diplomatic maneuvering regarding the implementation of the Xi-Trump summit outcomes and market reactions to China's drive for tech independence are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Región Asie a Tichomoří čelí technologickému soupeření, což ilustruje snaha start-upu DeepSeek integrovat nástroje pro čipy Huawei a omezit závislost na Nvidia. Současně se zostřují obchodní vztahy s EU a roste obezřetnost ohledně dodavatelských řetězců, zatímco finanční trhy v Hongkongu vykazují rekordní oživení v oblasti IPO.
archive.security_status_en: The Asia-Pacific region is navigating intense technological rivalry, illustrated by DeepSeek's open-sourcing of tools for Huawei chips to reduce Nvidia dependency. Concurrently, EU-China trade tensions are tightening amid supply chain vulnerability warnings, while Hong Kong's financial markets post record-breaking IPO recovery.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat reakce na blížící se říjnová jednání mezi EU a Čínou a vývoj kolem technologických sankcí.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will react to upcoming October EU-China trade talks and developments surrounding tech sanctions.

archive.security_status_cs: Region zažívá smíšené období oslav čínského státního svátku a rostoucího průmyslového a technologického tlaku. Zatímco Čína posiluje své pozice v oblasti robotiky a elektromobility, diplomatická a bezpečnostní opatrnost v USA, Japonsku a Indonésii podtrhuje přetrvávající geopolitické třenice.
archive.security_status_en: The region is experiencing a mixed period of China's National Day celebrations and mounting industrial and technological pressure. While China strengthens its positions in robotics and EV exports, diplomatic and security caution in the US, Japan, and Indonesia underscores ongoing geopolitical friction.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat dozvuky čínského svátečního týdne a reakce na rostoucí asijské exportní ambice v oblasti technologií a elektromobility.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will likely see the aftermath of China's holiday week and reactions to expanding Asian export ambitions in tech and EVs.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí v regionu zůstává mírné až stabilní navzdory diplomatickým třenicím mezi Soulem a Kyjevem či napětí na Blízkém východě, které rezonuje globálními trhy. V Číně nadále probíhá technologický rozvoj pod přísným regulatorním dohledem, zatímco Hongkong těží ze stabilního přílivu zahraničního kapitálu i přes makroekonomické výzvy.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions in the region remain moderate to stable despite diplomatic friction between Seoul and Kyiv and Middle Eastern tensions resonating through global markets. China continues its technological advancement under tight regulatory oversight, while Hong Kong benefits from steady foreign capital inflows despite macroeconomic headwinds.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat reakce na diplomatické iniciativy mezi USA, Čínou a Ruskem před summitem APEC a vývoj kolem obchodních dohod.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets will likely react to diplomatic initiatives between the US, China, and Russia ahead of the APEC summit and trade agreement developments.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí v Indo-Pacifiku přetrvává, podpořené dodávkami stíhaček F-16V na Tchaj-wan a rostoucími obavami v Malajsii ohledně situace v Jihočínském moři. Ekonomický vývoj v regionu je smíšený: zatímco Hongkong hlásí oživení maloobchodních tržeb během svátků, IPO trh nadále oslabuje a technologické restrikce (např. blokování VPN pro AI modely) se zostřují.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions in the Indo-Pacific remain evident, underscored by F-16V deliveries to Taiwan and rising maritime security anxieties in Malaysia regarding the South China Sea. Regional economic dynamics are mixed: while Hong Kong reports retail growth during holidays, its IPO market struggles and tech restrictions (such as VPN blocks for AI models) tighten.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat reakce trhů na data z hongkongského maloobchodu během svátků a pokračující diplomatické manévry kolem Tchajwanské úžiny.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to react to Hong Kong's holiday retail data and ongoing diplomatic maneuvers around the Taiwan Strait.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí se vyostřuje v souvislosti s americkými exportními kontrolami AI serverů a pokusy obcházet sankce přes jihovýchodní Asii. Washington mezitím stupňuje technologický a bezpečnostní tlak, včetně jaderných simulací a snah o zajištění alternativních dodávek kritických surovin, jako je wolfram a lithium.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions are escalating amid US export controls on AI servers and sanctions evasion schemes routed through Southeast Asia. Meanwhile, Washington is stepping up technological and security pressure, including nuclear simulations and efforts to secure alternative supplies of critical minerals like tungsten and lithium.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat reakce trhů na odhalené nelegální dodávky AI technologií do Číny a pokračující diplomatické manévry kolem kritických nerostných surovin. Pozornost se soustředí také na data z asijského maloobchodu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to react to the uncovered illicit AI technology shipments to China and ongoing diplomatic maneuvers surrounding critical minerals. Attention will also focus on Asian retail data.

archive.security_status_cs: Regina v regionu Asie a Tichomoří nadále dominují ekonomické a technologické iniciativy, včetně rozšiřování těžby lithia v Číně a vědecké spolupráce mezi USA a Čínou. Geopolitické napětí zůstává pod kontrolou, přičemž pozornost investorů se soustředí na spotřebitelskou poptávku a post-brexitovou obchodní politiku Velké Británie a EU.
archive.security_status_en: The Asia-Pacific region continues to be dominated by economic and technological initiatives, including expanded lithium mining in China and US-China scientific cooperation. Geopolitical tensions remain contained, with investor focus shifting towards consumer demand and post-Brexit trade policies between the UK and the EU.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zaměření trhů na data o spotřebitelské aktivitě v Číně po svátcích a dopady evropské obchodní politiky na automobilový sektor. Pozornost se bude ubírat také k dalším krokům v oblasti kritických surovin.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to focus on post-holiday consumer activity data in China and the implications of European trade policy on the automotive sector. Attention will also turn to further developments regarding critical raw materials.

archive.security_status_cs: Regionální napětí v Asii nadále roste v důsledku amerických vojenských kroků, jako je nasazení protilodních systémů NMESIS na japonském ostrově Jonačuni, a pokračujících provokací Severní Koreje. Na ekonomické frontě Čína mezitím posiluje svou pozici v oblasti kritických surovin expanzí nalezišť lithium a technologickou spoluprací, zatímco Hongkong těží ze silné sváteční návštěvnosti z pevniny.
archive.security_status_en: Regional tensions in Asia continue to mount driven by US military steps, such as the deployment of NMESIS anti-ship systems on Japan's Yonaguni Island, and ongoing provocations by North Korea. On the economic front, China is solidifying its position in critical raw materials via lithium mine expansions and tech collaboration, while Hong Kong benefits from strong holiday mainland visitor arrivals.
